alternatives_rejected.why: Injected delay mainly raises latency. Here callers also get errors (0.0->0.1715 inbound, E2), which points to dropped packets and failed retries rather than delay alone.
The socket spike (z=143, E3) is far smaller than the latency spike (z=931). It is better read as retransmits from loss. Logs also show successful conversions and no connection errors (E4).
Own span self-time barely changed (0.1->0.13ms, E2), and CPU was not among the top deviations in E3.
The frontend error spike (E1) is downstream impact of currencyservice: the inbound errors and latency start at currencyservice (E2).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and repair the network path to the currencyservice pods (remove any injected packet-loss/tc netem rules, check the CNI/node NIC), and reschedule the pods if loss persists. Verify that inbound error rate and p50 latency return to baseline.
